This is the default configuration for Tiny Tapeout projects. It should fit most designs.
If you change it, please make sure you understand what you are doing. We are not responsible
if your project fails because of a bad configuration.
!!! DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE unless you know what you are doing !!!
If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html

Save some time
Second-opinion DRC signoff. The TT default leaves this off to save
runtime, which means Magic is the only DRC deck that runs. The
ihp-sg13g2 PDK does ship a KLayout deck (KLAYOUT_DRC_RUNSET ->
libs.tech/klayout/tech/drc/ihp-sg13g2.drc), so enabling this is a real
independent check rather than a skipped step.
Don't put clock buffers on the outputs
Reduce wasted space
Absolute die size
Clock
CTS_SINK_CLUSTERING_SIZE is deliberately left unset (TritonCTS then
uses its own default of 20 sinks per leaf cluster). That is why the 14
clkbuf_leaf_* buffers drive 11-17 flops each and trip
design__max_fanout_violation__count against the sg13g2
MAX_FANOUT_CONSTRAINT of 10.
Setting it to 8 does fix the rule (measured fanout distribution became
2:1, 3:4, 4:8, 5:1, 7:1, 8:22 -- every leaf within the limit) but this
tile cannot afford it. Leaf buffers go 14 -> 29 and clock-cell area
~600 -> 1254 um^2; after the usual +20% hold repair that lands at
~27870 um^2 against 28941 um^2 of free area, and
OpenROAD.ResizerTimingPostCTS dies with DPL-0036 (detailed placement
failed, 4 instances unplaceable). The green flow sits at ~27378 um^2,
so there is only ~500 um^2 of headroom and the bigger clock tree eats
all of it.
The violations are cosmetic here: slew, cap and skew are all clean and
the clock closes with margin. Do not re-add this without first freeing
area elsewhere.
Don't generate power rings
MAGIC_DEF_LABELS may cause issues with LVS
